en.title: NUTS Weekly Tournament Digest: How Not to Miss the Best GTD — Nuts PPPoker
en.description: How to follow the weekly NUTS tournament schedule: Telegram, PPPoker lobby, boosted GTD series and mini highrollers. Guide from the tournament director.
en.bodyHtml:
Author: Asel Kasymova, NUTS Tournament Director

Published: June 2027

Every week dozens of tournaments start at NUTS — from $0.50 freezeouts to series with GTD $1000+. Missing the best one is easy. Here is how I track the grid and where to look so you do not scroll the lobby for an hour.

3 channels you cannot skip

  1. NUTS Telegram channel — series and GTD announcements land here first
  2. PPPoker lobby — Tournaments section in club ID 111777, filter by start time
  3. Manager — @NUTSsup will suggest series for your bankroll

A typical NUTS week

DayWhat to look for
Mon–WedMicro MTT, SNG, training freezeouts
Thu–FriBoosted GTD series, PKO tournaments
Sat–SunMain weekly guarantees, mini highrollers

Exact schedule changes — see how to read the tournament grid and Telegram announcements.

What to watch

  • GTD / overlay — guarantee above total buy-ins = value
  • Format — freezeout, PKO, turbo, deepstack — pick your style
  • Start time — Moscow evening and weekends = more recreational players
  • Bankroll — 100+ ABI for your schedule, bankroll management

Mini highrollers and series

Every few weeks — special series with boosted GTD. Example: mini highroller. Watch the channel — announcement 1–3 days ahead.

SNG vs MTT on weekdays

Short on time weekdays — SNG in 30–60 minutes. Weekends — MTT with big GTD. Comparison: SNG vs MTT at NUTS.

Pre-registration checklist

  1. Do you have 2–4 hours until the final (for MTT)
  2. Enough bankroll for 2–3 re-entries
  3. Structure fits (turbo vs deepstack)
  4. Checked GTD and overlay

Club 111777. Join · Telegram channel
